note: Machine-readable constants for spec v3. SPEC.md is normative and wins if the two ever disagree. Frozen: any change to a value here changes names and requires a new major spec version.

input.normalisation: lowercase A-Z to a-z; every other character unchanged; no trimming

hash.note: The 'v2' and '|0' in the message are frozen constants kept for compatibility with names Quantascan published under spec v2. They are not the spec version.

integer.source: digest bytes 26 to 31 (zero-based: the last 6 bytes)

tag: tag_head rendered, then tag_tail rendered; each rendered least-significant character first
